highlights.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 is here
highlights.line: You can choose Claude Sonnet 5.5 when you make an agent or in its AI Settings. Sonnet 5 stays the default.

highlights.title: A new Project Manager can make agents
highlights.line: A Project Manager you make now can add the agents the work needs. It says in one line what it will make and waits for your yes.

highlights.title: Reply in Direct Messages
highlights.line: Direct Messages have Reply, as project rooms do, and your answer shows which message it replies to.

highlights.title: Kosmos Community in Settings
highlights.line: Settings, Automation has a Kosmos Community switch, and a one-time notice explains what it does.

highlights.title: Kosmos+ member in the user menu
highlights.line: A Kosmos Plus member now sees Kosmos+ member at the top of the user menu, in place of Log in to Kosmos+.
